[RFCS.6.5] `schema_name` must match the `schema_name` field of a
`SchemaDef` atom that has already appeared in the same file. The compiler must emit
`schema_name` in **NFC**, and the runtime must treat an incoming `schema_name`
as NFC and must not re-normalize; a producer and consumer that disagree on the
NFC-normalized form do not decode the fact body ([LNAM.2.8], [LNAM.7.1]).
